1.explanation:
- Breadcrumb/README.md provides the overall API and documents the skeleton variant usage.
- Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.js contains the logic that decides when to render the skeleton variant and how the <a> elements are output.
- Breadcrumb/BreadcrumbItem.js defines each individual breadcrumb item and is responsible for rendering the link wrapper around the placeholder.
- Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.stories.js (or .stories.jsx) shows how the skeleton variant is set up in Storybook; it’s what you use to reproduce the exact scenario and verify the DAP error.
- SkeletonPlaceholder/SkeletonPlaceholder.js is the generic placeholder component used inside the skeleton links; having its code lets you see if it could carry alt text or other accessibility attributes.
- SkeletonText/SkeletonText.js is often used alongside SkeletonPlaceholder for textual skeletons; inspecting it helps determine if an alternative placeholder with accessible text could be used instead.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in the “Skeleton” variant of the Breadcrumb component. In the Storybook screenshot you can see a row of grey bars (the skeleton placeholders) separated by “/” dividers. Under the hood each skeleton placeholder is rendered as an empty <a> tag (no text or alt text) wrapping a SkeletonPlaceholder. When running the IBM DAP accessibility check, each of those anchor elements is flagged for “Hyperlink is missing link text or an image with alt text,” leading to a DAP violation on every breadcrumb item in the skeleton state.
